cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your garden gnome has come back from the exhibition. Sit here with me; you remember how I taught you to lay out a repair before starting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you brought it in a box?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're checking the packaging now. Good. It's in several pieces, wrapped separately so we can see what fits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Most of it. The hat is missing, but the face is whole. Start with the smile, the way I showed you; I'll find the glue while you look at that bit.
